languageTip: Applies to the framework and plugins that provide language packs.
pluginDirectoryTip: Must be a persistent directory below /data. Existing plugins are copied and the old directory is retained for recovery.
onlineUpdateTip: Downloads the release selected by the official update index, verifies its size and SHA-256, and restores the previous framework if installation fails.
frameworkUpToDate: v{version} is the latest indexed release
onlineUpdateConfirm: Update MWEF from v{current} to v{latest}? The current framework will be retained in the recovery directory.
sameVersionUpdateConfirm: Reinstall MWEF v{version} from the verified online release? The current framework will be retained for recovery.
updatingFramework: Validating and updating the framework. Do not close this page…
uploadFrameworkReleaseTip: Upload an official mwef-<version>.tar.gz release. A confirmation is shown after validation.
uploadingFramework: Uploading and validating the framework release…
uploadUpdateConfirm: Install MWEF v{version} from the uploaded release? The installed version is v{current}.
frameworkPackageExtension: Choose an MWEF .tar.gz or .tgz release package.
frameworkPackageSize: The MWEF release package must be smaller than 16 MiB.
pluginPackageTip: Choose a compliant .tar.gz package. Requested permissions are shown before installation.
permissionIntro: Grant only permissions the plugin needs. Shell permission allows declared scripts to run and should be enabled with care.
removeConfirm: The plugin will be moved to the recovery directory. Continue?
noPermissionsRequested: This plugin requests no extra permissions.
permissionSystemReadHelp: Read kernel, hardware, load, and other read-only runtime information.
permissionFilesystemReadHelp: Read router files within the scope declared by the plugin.
permissionFilesystemWriteHelp: Write to the plugin directory or declared data directories.
permissionNetworkClientHelp: Connect from the router to external network services.
permissionServiceControlHelp: Start, stop, or reload declared system services.
permissionShellExecuteHelp: Run declared Shell scripts from the plugin package; this is a high-risk permission.
